source_text: That leads to our warehouse.

text: 那儿通向我们的货仓。

text: It can only be opened from the other side.

text: 这只能另外一边打开。

text: You're a strange one.

text: 你真是个奇怪的人。

text: You're wastin' your time.

text: 你在浪费时间。

text: He ignores you.

text: 他不理你。

text: So? Do you want a job or what? I'm offerin' you a great chance at some excitement and lots of cash! You can never have too much of either!
source_text: So? Do you want a job or what? I'm offerin' you a great chance at some excitement and lots of cash! You can never have too much of either!

text: 那么，你想要个工作还是？我很乐意给你个机会和大把的钱！你再也不会得到比这个更多的了！
source_text: 那么，你想要个工作还是？我很乐意给你个机会和大把的钱！你再也不会得到比这个更多的了！

text: Oh, yeah. How much was that?
source_text: Oh, yeah. How much was that?

text: 噢，是的，那有多少？
source_text: 噢，是的，那有多少？

text: I'll kill anything that gets in our way!
source_text: I'll kill anything that gets in our way!

text: 谁敢挡我的路我就干掉谁！
source_text: 谁敢挡我的路我就干掉谁！

text: No, thanks.
source_text: No, thanks.

text: 不，谢谢。
source_text: 不，谢谢。

text: I need a water chip.
source_text: I need a water chip.

text: 我需要一块净水芯片。

text: What do you know about the missing caravans?

text: 关于失踪的商队你知道些什么？

text: I've got to go.
source_text: I've got to go.

text: 我得走了。
source_text: 我得走了。

text: Ruk luk?
source_text: Ruk luk?

text: 啊哈？
source_text: 啊哈？

text: Hey, you did a fine job on that last caravan -- good goin'! Did you need somethin'?
source_text: Hey, you did a fine job on that last caravan -- good goin'! Did you need somethin'?

text: 嘿，关于上一趟商队你做得很好--漂亮！你还想要些工作吗？
source_text: 嘿，关于上一趟商队你做得很好--漂亮！你还想要些工作吗？

text: Yeah, I wanted another job.
source_text: Yeah, I wanted another job.

text: 是的，我想要另一个工作。

text: No.  Just stopped by to say hi.
source_text: No.  Just stopped by to say hi.

text: 不，只是说嗨就停止。
source_text: 不，只是说嗨就停止。

text: Nothing, bye.

text: 没什么，再见。
source_text: 没什么，再见。

text: We lost all of our cargo! I'm afraid we can't hire you anymore, sorry.
source_text: We lost all of our cargo! I'm afraid we can't hire you anymore, sorry.

text: 我们失去了所有的货物！我恐怕不能再雇佣你了，对不起。
source_text: 我们失去了所有的货物！我恐怕不能再雇佣你了，对不起。

text: You're lucky, we almost lost that caravan you bugged out on! I'm afraid we can't hire you for any more jobs, sorry.
source_text: You're lucky, we almost lost that caravan you bugged out on! I'm afraid we can't hire you for any more jobs, sorry.

text: 你真幸运，我们几乎失去了你捣乱的那个商队，我恐怕不能再给你更多的工作了，抱歉！
source_text: 你真幸运，我们几乎失去了你捣乱的那个商队，我恐怕不能再给你更多的工作了，抱歉！

text: We're not hiring, so what do you want?
source_text: We're not hiring, so what do you want?

text: 我们不雇佣人，那么你想要什么？
source_text: 我们不雇佣人，那么你想要什么？

text: Get lost! We're not hiring.
source_text: Get lost! We're not hiring.

text: 滚开！我们不雇佣人。

text: I need a water chip.

text: 我需要一块净水芯片。

text: Tell me what you know about the missing caravans.
source_text: Tell me what you know about the missing caravans.

text: 告诉我你所知道的关于失踪商队的事情。
source_text: 告诉我你所知道的关于失踪商队的事情。

text: I want your ugly face out of my way!
source_text: I want your ugly face out of my way!

text: 你这张丑脸快从我面前消失！
source_text: 你这张丑脸快从我面前消失！

text: I want your head on a stick!
source_text: I want your head on a stick!

text: 我要把你的头插在一根棍子上！
source_text: 我要把你的头插在一根棍子上！

text: Never mind.
source_text: Never mind.

text: 别在意。
source_text: 别在意。

text: Ruk luk?
source_text: Ruk luk?

text: 啊哈？
source_text: 啊哈？

text: You think you're tough? Don't make me laugh!
source_text: You think you're tough? Don't make me laugh!

text: 你认为自己很强壮？别逗我笑了！
source_text: 你认为自己很强壮？别逗我笑了！

text: Well, you should be talking to my daughter, Keri; she takes care of all that!  She's in the next room.
source_text: Well, you should be talking to my daughter, Keri; she takes care of all that!  She's in the next room.

text: 好吧，你可以和我的女儿凯利谈谈，她安排这些事！她就在另外一个屋子里。
source_text: 好吧，你可以和我的女儿凯利谈谈，她安排这些事！她就在另外一个屋子里。

text: I already told you. Just talk to Keri in the next room.
source_text: I already told you. Just talk to Keri in the next room.

text: 我已经跟你说过了，去找另一个屋里的凯利。
source_text: 我已经跟你说过了，去找另一个屋里的凯利。

text: Your daughter?
source_text: Your daughter?

text: 你女儿？
source_text: 你女儿？

text: That ugly thing is your daughter?  That explains a lot!
source_text: That ugly thing is your daughter?  That explains a lot!

text: 那个丑东西是你女儿？这就可以解释很多事情了！
source_text: 那个丑东西是你女儿？这就可以解释很多事情了！

text: Okay.
source_text: Okay.

text: 好的。
source_text: 好的。

text: Yes, she's my pride and joy! Isn't she beautiful? Just talk to her when you want another job. Some day . . . hopefully soon, I'll be able to retire and she'll take over for me.
source_text: Yes, she's my pride and joy! Isn't she beautiful? Just talk to her when you want another job. Some day . . . hopefully soon, I'll be able to retire and she'll take over for me.

text: 是的，她是我的骄傲和快乐！难道她不漂亮吗？当你想要工作时尽管去找她。过些日子……但愿没多久，我能退休让她来接替我。
source_text: 是的，她是我的骄傲和快乐！难道她不漂亮吗？当你想要工作时尽管去找她。过些日子……但愿没多久，我能退休让她来接替我。

text: You can't if you're both dead!
source_text: You can't if you're both dead!

text: 除非你们都死了，否则这是不可能的！
source_text: 除非你们都死了，否则这是不可能的！

text: Okay, thanks.
source_text: Okay, thanks.

text: 好的，谢谢。

text: You dare insult someone's family? I should rip your heart out!
source_text: You dare insult someone's family? I should rip your heart out!

text: 你竟敢侮辱别人的家庭！我该把你的心掏出来！
source_text: 你竟敢侮辱别人的家庭！我该把你的心掏出来！

text: 很抱歉，我只是在开玩笑！

text: I'll do more than insult you!
source_text: I'll do more than insult you!

text: 我不光是要侮辱你们！
source_text: 我不光是要侮辱你们！

text: Too late for apologies! 【His face gets very red . . . then in a calm, controlled voice.】 Get, before I make good on my threat!
source_text: Too late for apologies! 【His face gets very red . . . then in a calm, controlled voice.】 Get, before I make good on my threat!

text: 说抱歉太迟了！【他的脸变得通红……然后平静下来，控制着语气。】走吧，在我发火以前！
source_text: 说抱歉太迟了！【他的脸变得通红……然后平静下来，控制着语气。】走吧，在我发火以前！
